claims.claim_text: RA 9266 IRR Section 3(2) defines Architect, Architect-of-Record, Architect-in-Charge of Construction, and Consulting Architect.
RA 9266 IRR Section 3(3) defines General Practice of Architecture to include planning, architectural design, structural conceptualization, specifying, supervision, and responsible direction.
RA 9266 IRR Section 3(4) lists ten service categories under the scope of architectural practice.
The prior learner-facing Section 20 locator for scope categories was removed and replaced with Section 3(4).

Question edits staged locally for linked question IDs/model IDs: ae2dd470-af9a-49d3-b2ae-03968c51a4a1 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-001), 64f87401-24fd-4f73-803f-d7f9a006c03a (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-010), 08a1c4ca-fe39-4ded-81c4-94909a6d362c (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-004), 470f33bb-24f1-4eb2-a76e-ce255a50ae41 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-008), 5799550f-7a5e-4e16-a921-a7551b075bc0 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-006), c47a6715-b32f-4649-8692-cc3e1a1a63b3 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-002), c7d3979b-6241-480e-a37d-28cfd4af00d8 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-005), cfc6c973-ed50-4948-9c47-48a8fadf5dd7 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-007), 7d7ae21c-dcec-43f0-8403-b4117dcd1c89 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-003), d64a8825-1fc6-469c-85a7-b67fea123907 (ALE-PRAC-LAW-002-009)

The Real World Scenario classifies site analysis, schematic design, plans, estimates, space planning, and utility layout coordination as architectural services when they are within the commissioned architectural scope.
